seo.title: Can Bordoy Grand House & Garden: Palma Mansion Honeymoon Review (2026)
seo.description: 24-key 16th-century mansion with secret garden and underground pool in Palma's La Lonja quarter. Honest 2026 verdict, real cost, best room, 7-night itinerary.

content.verdict: Can Bordoy Grand House & Garden is the most romantic small hotel in Palma — a 16th-century palatial mansion in the narrow streets of the La Lonja quarter, transformed in 2018 by Catalan architect Mercè Borràs into a 24-key adults-only retreat with a secret 800 sqm walled garden (the largest private garden inside Palma's old city walls), an underground stone pool in the original cisterns, and a rooftop with the closest cathedral view of any hotel in the city. The restoration preserved the mansion's original frescoed ceilings, hand-painted azulejos, and the carved-stone Renaissance staircase, then layered in custom Italian linens, rainshowers, and a 12-table Botànic restaurant whose foraged-herb menu draws the city's serious diners. With no children, an obsessive attention to detail (handwritten welcome notes, in-suite herbal tea blends, a small but excellent spa in the vaulted cellars), and direct walking access to La Seu, the Born, and the seafront, this is Palma's defining honeymoon address — quieter and more intimate than Sant Francesc, more architecturally serious than any other boutique in the city.
content.best_room: A Grand Garden Suite is the honeymoon room — a corner suite on the principal floor with original 16th-century frescoes overhead, French doors opening to a private terrace over the secret garden, a free-standing copper soaking tub, and the property's most preserved historic detail. For ultimate splurge, the Bordoy Suite at 95 sqm occupies the mansion's original main reception with two balconies, a separate sitting room, and an outdoor jacuzzi on a private rooftop terrace. The Garden View rooms on the lower floor open directly to the walled garden — perfect for couples who want garden-immersed mornings.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival at La Lonja
itinerary_7_nights.description: Palma airport is 15 minutes from Can Bordoy. Walk through the narrow stone-paved streets to the discreet wooden gate, check into your Grand Garden Suite, and order an aperitivo in the secret garden as evening light catches the orange trees. First-night dinner at Botànic — the courtyard restaurant where chef Andrés Benítez sends out a 7-course foraged-herb tasting.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Cathedral & La Seu Morning
itinerary_7_nights.description: La Seu opens at 10am — Can Bordoy is a 5-minute walk away. Spend the morning inside the cathedral with the Gaudí canopy and Miquel Barceló chapel. Lunch at Marc Fosh (Michelin-starred), an afternoon walking the Born and shopping at Rialto Living, sunset cocktails at the Can Bordoy rooftop with the closest cathedral view in the city, and a quiet in-suite dinner from the Botànic kitchen.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Underground Pool & Spa Day
itinerary_7_nights.description: A complete inside day — morning in the underground pool (a stone-vaulted swimming chamber in the original cisterns, lit by candles), 90-minute couples treatment in the cellar spa, long lunch in the garden, and an afternoon reading in the courtyard. Dinner at Adrián Quetglas (Michelin-starred, Mallorcan-Russian fusion, a 5-minute walk away).

itinerary_7_nights.title: Cap Rocat for Lunch & the South Coast
itinerary_7_nights.description: A 15-minute drive south to Cap Rocat for a long lunch on the fortress terrace overlooking Palma Bay (open to non-guests by reservation). Afternoon at Es Trenc beach (Mallorca's longest natural sandy beach, 45 minutes from Cap Rocat). Return for a quiet dinner on the Can Bordoy rooftop.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Tramuntana — Deià & Sóller
itinerary_7_nights.description: A 45-minute drive into the Tramuntana mountains — coffee at Valldemossa, the cliff-edge village walk in Deià, lunch at El Olivo at Belmond La Residencia, the wooden tram down to Port de Sóller. Late return for cocktails in the secret garden and a final dinner at Botànic.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Boat Day from Port d'Andratx
itinerary_7_nights.description: A 30-minute drive west to Port d'Andratx — Mallorca's most discreet marina — for a private day-charter along the dramatic south-west coast. Sa Dragonera nature reserve, the cliffs of Cala Egos, lunch anchored off Camp de Mar. Return for an aperitivo on the rooftop as cathedral lights come on.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Garden Morning & Departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Breakfast served in the secret garden under the orange trees, a final walk to La Seu before the cruise crowds, and the 15-minute transfer to the airport. Can Bordoy is the rare boutique that consistently produces guests who book a return stay before leaving.

caveats: Can Bordoy is in Palma's old quarter — narrow streets without car access. The hotel arranges porter assistance with luggage from the nearest taxi point (a 2-minute walk); guests with significant mobility constraints should discuss in advance.

There is no beach access — pair with a coastal hotel (Hospes Maricel, Cap Rocat) for split-stays that combine city and sea. Or use the property as the city anchor with day trips to Cap Rocat and Es Trenc.
Botànic restaurant has only 12 tables and operates as the hotel's exclusive dining — book the tasting menu at the time of room reservation to guarantee availability.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Can Bordoy is among the Mediterranean's most romantic small hotels — the combination of secret garden, underground candlelit pool, original 16th-century frescoes, and adults-only positioning creates an intimacy that is rare anywhere in Europe. Honeymoon couples are the property's dominant demographic.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: April–June and September–November are ideal — pleasant city walking, garden in flower, terrace-dining weather. The hotel stays open year-round; even winter is excellent for a quiet city stay with the underground pool and spa as the focus.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: Grand Garden Suite categories book 4–6 months ahead for high season; the Bordoy Suite needs 6+ months for summer. The 24-key scale means availability is genuinely constrained.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: Yes — Can Bordoy is strictly adults-only (16+ year-round). The intimacy of the secret garden and the quiet of the historic mansion depend on this policy and create the honeymoon atmosphere.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Grand Garden Suite on the principal floor for original frescoes, copper soaking tub, and a terrace over the secret garden. For ultimate splurge, the Bordoy Suite at 95 sqm has private rooftop jacuzzi and two balconies.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: Palma de Mallorca (PMI) is 15 minutes by taxi to the nearest drop-off point in the old quarter. The hotel arranges transfers for around €60 one-way and a porter to meet you at the drop-off for the 2-minute walk to the wooden gate.
